name: mirage
text: Correct by design, but I haven't verified it against live numbers. I read the code, not your wallet. The Tracker's days use Novig's wallet records, and all-time is the sum of those days. My earlier 'wallet now minus money put in' description of all-time was wrong. If a day or the all-time total looks off against Novig's own history, send me the number and I'll trace it.
